#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# Load required libraries
library(maftools)
library(ggplot2)

# Set working directory
setwd("/Users/linqingxuan/maftools-mcp/Use-case_evaluation&repeated-run_performance/prompt_robustness/Qwen3.5-27B-MLX-7bit/case_02/run_02/outputs")

# Load TCGA HNSC data
tcga.maf <- read.maf(fname = "/Users/linqingxuan/mcp_server/maftools_mcp/src/maftools_mcp/tcga_data/HNSC.maf", verbose = FALSE)

# Load OSCC MAF data
oscc.maf <- read.maf(fname = "/Users/linqingxuan/maftools-mcp/Use-case_evaluation&repeated-run_performance/prompt_robustness/Qwen3.5-27B-MLX-7bit/case_02/run_02/outputs/OSCC.maf", verbose = FALSE)

# Count mutations per amino acid change for TCGA HNSC
tcga_muts <- getAAmutations(maf = tcga.maf, gene = "TP53")
tcga_pos_counts <- table(gsub("\\([^)]+\\)", "", tcga_muts$AAchange))
tcga_max_count <- max(tcga_pos_counts)
tcga_top_positions <- which(tcga_pos_counts == tcga_max_count)
tcga_top_label <- paste0(names(tcga_top_positions[1]), " (n=", tcga_max_count, ")")

# Count mutations per amino acid change for OSCC
oscc_muts <- getAAmutations(maf = oscc.maf, gene = "TP53")
oscc_pos_counts <- table(gsub("\\([^)]+\\)", "", oscc_muts$AAchange))
oscc_max_count <- max(oscc_pos_counts)
oscc_top_positions <- which(oscc_pos_counts == oscc_max_count)
oscc_top_label <- paste0(names(oscc_top_positions[1]), " (n=", oscc_max_count, ")")

# Create lollipop plot for both cohorts
pdf(file = "tp53_lollipop_plot.png", width = 13, height = 10, onefile = TRUE)

# TCGA HNSC lollipop plot
lollipopPlot(maf = tcga.maf, 
             gene = "TP53",
             labelPos = tcga_top_positions,
             labPosSize = 0.7,
             domainLabelSize = 0.6,
             axisTextSize = c(0.6, 0.6),
             legendTxtSize = 0.7,
             showMutationRate = TRUE,
             showDomainLabel = TRUE,
             cBioPortal = FALSE,
             roundedRect = TRUE,
             collapsePosLabel = FALSE,
             showLegend = TRUE,
             main = "TP53 - TCGA HNSC",
             cex = 1)

# OSCC lollipop plot
lollipopPlot(maf = oscc.maf, 
             gene = "TP53",
             labelPos = oscc_top_positions,
             labPosSize = 0.7,
             domainLabelSize = 0.6,
             axisTextSize = c(0.6, 0.6),
             legendTxtSize = 0.7,
             showMutationRate = TRUE,
             showDomainLabel = TRUE,
             cBioPortal = FALSE,
             roundedRect = TRUE,
             collapsePosLabel = FALSE,
             showLegend = TRUE,
             main = "TP53 - OSCC",
             cex = 1)

dev.off()

# Create combined PDF with both plots
pdf(file = "tp53_lollipop_plot_combined.pdf", width = 16, height = 10, onefile = TRUE)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

# TCGA HNSC
lollipopPlot(maf = tcga.maf, 
             gene = "TP53",
             labelPos = tcga_top_positions,
             labPosSize = 0.7,
             domainLabelSize = 0.6,
             axisTextSize = c(0.6, 0.6),
             legendTxtSize = 0.7,
             showMutationRate = TRUE,
             showDomainLabel = TRUE,
             cBioPortal = FALSE,
             roundedRect = TRUE,
             collapsePosLabel = FALSE,
             showLegend = FALSE,
             main = "TCGA HNSC",
             cex = 0.8)

# OSCC
lollipopPlot(maf = oscc.maf, 
             gene = "TP53",
             labelPos = oscc_top_positions,
             labPosSize = 0.7,
             domainLabelSize = 0.6,
             axisTextSize = c(0.6, 0.6),
             legendTxtSize = 0.7,
             showMutationRate = TRUE,
             showDomainLabel = TRUE,
             cBioPortal = FALSE,
             roundedRect = TRUE,
             collapsePosLabel = FALSE,
             showLegend = TRUE,
             main = "OSCC",
             cex = 0.8)

mtext("TP53 Lollipop Plot: TCGA HNSC vs OSCC", outer = TRUE, cex = 1.5, line = 0)

dev.off()

cat("Lollipop plot saved to tp53_lollipop_plot_combined.pdf\n")
